class.name: CgameOffMeshLinkGenerator
class.brief_description: Generates drop, jump and gap links from a heightfield and can create them as [NavigationServer3D] links.
class.description: [CgameOffMeshLinkGenerator] finds traversals a walkable grid cannot express: ledge drops, small climbs and short gaps. Each result is a [Dictionary] with the keys [code]from[/code] ([Vector2i]), [code]to[/code] ([Vector2i]), [code]kind[/code] ([String]) and [code]bidirectional[/code] ([bool]). Link kinds: - [code]"drop"[/code]: one-way ledge down between adjacent walkable cells (height gap above [code]walk_step[/code], up to [code]max_drop[/code]). - [code]"jump"[/code]: bidirectional small climb between adjacent walkable cells (gap above [code]walk_step[/code], up to [code]max_jump_up[/code]). - [code]"gap"[/code]: bidirectional hop over 1 to [code]max_gap[/code] unwalkable cells between walkable cells of similar height. Cells are scanned row by row towards +X and +Y, so the order is deterministic and every pair appears once. [method create_links_on_map] turns links into [NavigationServer3D] links, the same primitive [NavigationLink3D] uses. Links created by an instance are freed when [method clear_map_links] is called or the instance is destroyed.

method.name: clear_map_links
method.description: Frees every [NavigationServer3D] link created by [method create_links_on_map].

method.name: create_links_on_map
method.description: Creates a [NavigationServer3D] link on [param map] for every entry of [param links] (the links from the last generation when empty) and returns how many were created. Cell centres are mapped to world space with [param origin_xz] and [param cell_size]; heights come from the last generated heightfield. Returns 0 when the map is invalid or the server is a dummy.

method.name: generate
method.description: Samples [code]height_at(x, y) -> float[/code] and [code]walkable(x, y) -> bool[/code] for every cell and generates links. Returns an empty array for invalid input.

method.name: generate_from_arrays
method.description: Same as [method generate], but reads row-major [param heights] and [param walkable] arrays of [code]width * height[/code] elements instead of calling callables.

method.name: get_last_links
method.description: Returns the links produced by the most recent generation.

method.name: get_map_link_count
method.description: Returns how many [NavigationServer3D] links this generator currently owns.

method.name: link_world_positions
method.description: Returns [code]{"start": Vector3, "end": Vector3}[/code], the world-space cell centres of [param link] at the heights of the last generated heightfield.
